entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: Part of the Evincar's quarters in the Stronghold, created by Volrath, housing physical manifestations of his memories and desires.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The Evincar of Rath, creator of the Dream Halls.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Structure on Rath housing the Dream Halls; later shifted to Urborg.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Weatherlight crewman who struck down Selenia and became a vampire.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Angel whom Crovax struck down; her shattered form entered his body.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member wounded by Selenia.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Returned Mirri and Crovax to the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Returned Mirri and Crovax to the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Shown visions in the Dream Halls and taunted by Volrath.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Left the Dream Halls with Gerrard and Sisay.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Emissary of Phyrexia who smashed Volrath's memory globes.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event when the Stronghold was shifted to Urborg.

events.summary: Crovax kills a shapeshifter mimicking Selenia; the real Selenia ambushes the Weatherlight crew and wounds Mirri.
events.quote: who wounded Mirri on a narrow bridge

events.summary: Crovax strikes Selenia down; her shattered form enters him and turns him into a vampire.
Volrath taunts Gerrard with mind-controlled Sisay and Takara; Gerrard defeats them.
Belbe smashes the globes of Volrath's dreams and memories.
events.quote: she took great pleasure in smashing the globes of Volrath's dreams and memories

events.summary: The Dream Halls are shifted with the Stronghold to Urborg.
events.quote: remnant of the Dream Halls were shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

relations.quote: The Dream Halls were created by Volrath himself.
